## Decision required

State the decision as one clear question.

## Why it blocks or constrains work

Identify the checkpoint, schema, security, privacy, tenancy or authoritative
record affected.

## Applicable authority

Link the relevant master-plan sections, accepted ADRs and specification.

## Options

### Option A

Describe the option and consequences.

### Option B

Describe the option and consequences.

## Recommendation

State the recommended option and evidence.

## Required approvers

Identify the accountable product, technical, security, privacy or academic
roles under `docs/adr/0001-approval-authority-and-evidence.md`. Name each role
that one human exercises; consolidated development roles are not independent
specialist review. Codex is never an approver.

## Approval evidence

When accepted, add an `APP-NNNN` entry using the durable evidence schema in
`docs/APPROVALS.md`. Record the exact human statement, bounded scope, artifact
revision, date and time zone, exercised roles, limitations, recorder and
master-plan impact. Link the evidence ID from the resulting ADR or
specification.

## Follow-up if accepted

List required ADR, master-plan, contract, test and status updates.
